name: Boston Tree Alliance Tree Planting and Care Grant Program
summary: Grants of up to $249,000 for nonprofit and community-based organisations to plant, maintain and run education on trees on privately owned land in under-canopied Boston neighbourhoods.

status.quote: is now accepting applications for the 2027 cycle of the Boston Tree Alliance Tree Planting and Care Grant Program.

deadline.quote: The deadline to apply is November 6, 2026.

administered_by.quote: The program is administered by Mass Audubon, in partnership with the City of Boston's Office of Climate Resilience

applicant_types.quote: This program provides funding support for nonprofit and community-based organizations to pursue tree planting, maintenance, and educational activities

geography.quote: on privately-owned land across Boston's under-canopied neighborhoods.
